Definition
[Generalized Dirichlet problem] 1. ch8:8.3–8.4\group ch08-generalized-solutions For $\varphi \in W^{1,2}(\Omega )$, a generalized solution $u\in W^{1,2}(\Omega )$ of (8.3) has boundary value $\varphi $ when $u-\varphi \in W_0^{1,2}(\Omega )$.
